body: Welcome to the epitome of mobile comfort and versatility—a custom camper van meticulously crafted by Papago Vans. Designed for adventurers who appreciate both style and functionality, this van showcases a sophisticated interior with a rich dark English chestnut stain and elegant black cabinets. The aesthetic is complemented by practical features that enhance every aspect of the journey.

At the heart of this van is the Roofnest Falcon 2 roof top tent, a game-changer for expanding sleeping capacity without crowding the interior space. Whether you're camping solo or with friends, this innovative addition provides a comfortable retreat under the stars. Inside, a plush memory foam full-size bed ensures restful nights, while recessed, dimmable LED ceiling lights create a cozy ambiance for winding down after a day of exploration.

Versatility meets convenience with swivel passenger and driver seats, offering flexibility for dining, lounging, or workspace setup. The Lagun swivel/adjustable table further enhances functionality, providing a stable surface for meals or planning your next adventure route. Safety is paramount, with essentials like a fire extinguisher, carbon monoxide/smoke detector, and strategically placed D-ring tie-down points for securing gear during travel.

External enhancements include a rugged roof rack paired with a rear door ladder, ideal for stowing bulky equipment or accessing the Roofnest tent with ease. A Nomadic electric awning extends outdoor living space, providing shade or shelter from the elements. Exterior perimeter lighting ensures visibility and security during nighttime stops, while magnetic blackout window coverings and bug screens offer privacy and protection wherever you roam.

For added convenience, the van includes a Alpicool LGT50 cooler/fridge, strategically placed in the garage on a non-slip mat, ensuring your provisions stay fresh throughout your journey. This custom camper van embodies the spirit of adventure and is meticulously engineered to elevate your van life experience to new heights.
